description:
Summer/ Winter Operating Area: Caribbean Virgin Islands (United States/British Virgin Islands), Caribbean Leewards, Caribbean Virgin Islands (United States), Caribbean Virgin Islands (British Virgin Islands)

JUST ENOUGH is a 42.98m / 141ft Motor Superyacht built in 2012 by Ares Marine with interior design by Ares Marine and later underwent a refit in 2024. Sleeping 11 guests in 5 cabins and with a crew of 9. Cruising at 12.00 kn/ph with a top speed of 18.00 kn/ph. The guest cabins comprise a Master cabin with a king size bed and en-suite bathroom facilities, 3 double cabins with a queen size bed and en-suite bathroom facilities, and a twin cabin with a twin bed and a pullman bed and en-suite bathroom facilities.

REFIT 2018-Engine/Crane/Generator overhaul. 
Sewage system and tanks cleaned and overhauled, water tank cleaned and painted, all new crew heads and flooring, new fresh air makeup system, new engine room ventilation system, new flooring in lazarette, new air handlers, new ac chiller.

crew.name: Chris Lee
crew.bio: With 25 years in the yachting industry, Chris brings a wealth of global experience to JUST ENOUGH. Having worked on super-yachts around the world, he leads with a steady hand and a warm heart. Deeply committed to both his guests and crew, Chris fosters a welcoming, family-like atmosphere onboard, ensuring every journey is safe, seamless, and memorable.

crew.name: Paul
crew.bio:
Originally from Houston, Texas, Paul has been drawn to the water for as long as he can remember. From earning his scuba diving certification at just 10 years old to spending his childhood fishing whenever he had the chance, his passion for the ocean has always been a defining part of his life.
With more than 12 years of experience in the yachting industry, Paul has worked his way from Deckhand to Mate aboard a variety of yachts around the world. His career has taken him far beyond the traditional cruising grounds, including time aboard a world expedition vessel exploring some of the most remote and extraordinary destinations on the planet, from Alaska to Papua New Guinea.
Before beginning his yachting career, Paul attended Sam Houston State University, where he earned degrees in Criminal Justice and Psychology while also playing American football. His background, extensive maritime experience, and adventurous spirit have shaped him into a confident, capable, and personable crew member.
Warm, welcoming, and always ready with a smile, Paul takes pride in making guests feel at home from the moment they step aboard JUST ENOUGH. His easygoing personality, love of the ocean, and genuine enjoyment of meeting new people make him a valued member of the crew and a pleasure to be around.

crew.name: Dylan
crew.bio: Meet Dylan, our South African Meet Dylan - our Chief Engineer whose expertise keeps JUST ENOUGH running at peak performance. This South African brings extensive experience in mechanical, electrical, and technical systems, ensuring every aspect of the vessel operates seamlessly. His comprehensive skill set includes everything from complex troubleshooting and hydraulics management to automated systems maintenance and welding. His background as a land-based diesel/petrol mechanic adds depth to his maritime engineering skills, while his focus on preventative maintenance and safety compliance gives guests and crew complete peace of mind. Understanding that a charter can be a once-in-a-lifetime experience, Dylan approaches each day with dedication to excellence, whether he’s managing complex systems or piloting tenders through the Caribbean’s beautiful waters. His sharp problem-solving abilities, combined with excellent budgeting and cost control skills, make him an invaluable asset to the vessel. Dylan’s appreciation for good weather, beautiful locations, and the warmth of local Caribbean culture adds to his commitment to ensuring every guest experiences the absolute best of life at sea.

crew.name: Mathew
crew.bio:
Matt Wood is the Mate aboard JUST ENOUGH, bringing more than a decade of experience in the luxury yachting industry. Having worked aboard both private and charter yachts up to 63 metres, Matt is a highly capable deck professional known for his strong leadership, technical expertise, and calm, personable nature.
His experience covers all aspects of deck operations, including tender driving, guest logistics, safety management, watersports, and day-to-day exterior operations. Matt takes pride in ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes while helping create a safe, relaxed, and enjoyable experience for guests onboard.
Throughout his career, Matt has worked aboard a number of well-regarded yachts cruising the Mediterranean, Caribbean, and Bahamas, earning a reputation for reliability, high standards, and a hands-on approach.
In addition to his yachting experience, Matt is also a professional videographer and photographer, bringing a creative eye to capturing memorable moments for guests and owners. His experience, attention to detail, and easygoing personality make him a valuable member of the JUST ENOUGH crew.

crew.name: Rayno
crew.bio: Hey folks, welcome aboard—stoked to have you with us! I’m Rayno de Wet, your deckhand for this trip. I come from a pretty hands-on background—spent over a decade managing drilling operations and another 16 years in the fitness world. So yeah, I’m all about staying sharp, staying active, and making sure things run smooth out here. Whether it’s setting up water toys, helping you get settled, or keeping the deck looking tight—I’m here to make sure you have an awesome time and everything’s taken care of behind the scenes.

crew.name: Natricia
crew.bio:
Natricia is a passionate chef inspired by nature, fresh ingredients, and the art of creating exceptional dining experiences. Born and raised in South Africa, her cooking reflects a rich blend of cultural influences, combining flavours and techniques from Asian fusion, Indian, Thai, Mediterranean, and classic French cuisines.
With a love for molecular gastronomy and innovative presentation, Natricia enjoys transforming fresh, quality ingredients into creative dishes that excite the senses and leave lasting memories.
Having fulfilled her entrepreneurial dream of opening her own Italian restaurant, she brings together culinary artistry, international influences, and a genuine passion for food to create unique, personalized dining experiences for every guest.

crew.name: Grace Bellavia
crew.bio:
Grace brings warmth, creativity, and confident leadership to her role as Chief Stewardess aboard Just Enough. With experience as both Chief and Second Stewardess on charter yachts, she combines an eye for detail with a natural ability to make guests feel welcome from the moment they step aboard.
From elegant table settings and thoughtful service to themed evenings and personal touches, Grace loves creating experiences that make each charter memorable. Behind the scenes, she keeps the interior organized and takes pride in training and supporting her team, bringing out the best in those around her. Her bubbly personality, infectious laugh, and hands-on approach keep spirits high, even on the busiest days.
Outside of yachting, Grace enjoys fitness, travel, photography, and life by the water. Guests can expect attentive service, a friendly face, and someone who takes as much care with the little details as the big occasions

crew.name: Chloe
crew.bio:
Chloe brings on board just the right balance of calm, bubbly energy, and humour to her role as second stewardess aboard Just Enough. Born and raised in Ireland, she has yachting experience ranging from the Mediterranean to the Caribbean and a genuine passion for creating unforgettable guest experiences.
Chloe loves creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere where guests feel at home, allowing them to switch off from everyday life, relax, and have fun. With her friendly nature and attention to detail, she enjoys making sure every guest feels comfortable and well looked after, always adding a little laughter along the way.
Alongside her yachting experience, Chloe has a background in nannying and fashion styling, allowing her to offer an extra helping hand to families and wardrobe assistance to guests. Outside of work, she enjoys being by the sea, traveling, photography, and hiking, reflecting her adventurous spirit and love for the outdoors.

crew.name: Keira
crew.bio:
Keira is a motivated and enthusiastic Third Stewardess aboard JUST ENOUGH, bringing a strong work ethic, keen attention to detail, and a hands-on approach to her role. She takes pride in maintaining high standards of cleanliness, organization, and presentation while helping to create a welcoming and enjoyable experience for guests.
Reliable, adaptable, and quick to respond, Keira works seamlessly as part of the interior team and approaches every task with a positive and professional attitude. She is attentive to guest needs, takes pride in excellent service, and is always ready to assist wherever needed to ensure life onboard runs smoothly.
Keira’s enthusiasm, professionalism, and commitment to high standards make her a valued member of the JUST ENOUGH crew and help ensure guests feel comfortable, well cared for, and at home throughout their time onboard.
